title: UPSC Principal, Vice Principal Online Form 2026
postName: Principal / Vice Principal (various institutions under UPSC advt)
vacancyDetails: Principal and Vice Principal posts as advertised by UPSC for central institutions / NVS / related cadres
qualification: Post Graduate degree with B.Ed. and teaching/administrative experience as per UPSC post rules
ageLimit: As per UPSC advertisement for Principal/Vice Principal posts
applicationFee: ₹25 for most candidates (exemptions for Female/SC/ST/PwBD as per UPSC)
selectionProcess: Recruitment Test / Shortlisting → Interview → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photos, signature, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.upsconline.nic.in
2. Complete One Time Registration
3. Open Principal / Vice Principal advertisement apply link
4. Fill ORA form and pay fee
5. Submit before closing date
shortDescription: UPSC Principal, Vice Principal Online Form 2026 – apply through upsconline.nic.in for advertised posts.
content:
Union Public Service Commission has invited online applications for Principal / Vice Principal posts as per the latest ORA advertisement.

Candidates must meet educational and experience criteria strictly. Apply only via upsconline.nic.in and keep experience certificates ready for interview stage.
